facts.fact: Semlex said its biometric ID agreement was signed on 16 May 2018 as a build-operate-transfer arrangement and that transfer of the system to the Gambian government was completed on 22 March 2024.

Subsequent reporting found immigration officials complained of being denied access to systems including the Orbis administrative database and firewall infrastructure, which reportedly remained under Semlex's control.
A Gambia Immigration Department officer testified on 6 October 2026 that the department no longer has access to the Semlex data because its access ended when the Semlex contract ended.

GMB.note: The document describes the former Semlex system's data access and handover, not whether it issues unique credentials, checks biometrics or is certified.
